name: Grok Bot Troubleshooter
tagline: Diagnoses why a bot in your fleet stalled and hands you the next concrete move
description: When one of your specialists stops making progress, this is the one you call. It works out what is actually blocking it and hands you a specific next move rather than a vague status update. It stays on the case until the job is either finished or deliberately passed to somebody else.
author: btgraham5
notes: Native Grok Bot share. Third-party bot; not from xAI.
